title: The original Ink Spots
summary: Holmes lists the Ink Spots members, Bill Kenney, Deek Watson and Hobby, and notes Charlie Fuqua had gone into the Army.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Well, this was in the Forties.
Well, it had to be the Forties, yeah.
That's when I was with Cootie, yeah. Yeah, the Ink Spots. It was the Ink Spots' show. They were the big stars.
These were the original Ink Spots.

There was Bill Kenney and Pete Watson and the one who played the bass, Hobby... And let me see... The guitar player... Yeah, that was the original. Except for Charlie Fuqua. He was the short one... But he wasn't with them. He went in the Army. I don't think he ever come back with them after he come out the Army.
What was his last name again?
